usa_vs_other.evidence_source: Participants were asked to self-select for the study according to the criteria provided: (a) Are you above age 18; (b) Are you an international student. All participants receive 50 CNY as the compensation of completing the survey.
usa_vs_other.warning: The compensation is in CNY (Chinese Yuan), indicating the study was likely conducted outside the USA, specifically in China.

section_summary.extract_value: This section details the participant recruitment and demographics for a single study. Participants were international students over 18, recruited via an online platform. Out of 400 respondents, 384 were included after excluding 16 for short answering times. The sample consisted of 153 males, 217 females, and 14 who preferred not to disclose gender, and participants were compensated with 50 CNY.
